prerequisites: Formula Student I (to be taken in parallel)

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of the degree.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Capacity for managing specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Capacity to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Capacity for organizing and planning resources and people in the business, and other institutions and organizations.
Capacity to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Adopt a responsible, orderly attitude at work and willingness to learn, considering the challenge posed by the necessary continuous training.
Apply the strategies of the scientific methodology: qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the problematic situation, propose hypotheses and solutions using engineering models.
Work effectively in a group, integrating capacities and knowledge to make decisions in the field of professional practice linked to the degree.

syllabus_topics: Project management: relationship with suppliers; planning; economic management; resource management; image, leadership and teamwork.
Management of Alliances and relationships with companies in the socioeconomic environment.
Management of project resources: budgets and expenses.
Management of tasks and temporal planning of the project.
Group management: Leadership, coordination and group work.
Development of a Case Study associated with design, manufacturing or business model, with a sustainable approach (in groups).
teaching_methods: Joint work in Formula Student competitions

assessment_methods.method: Attendance and active participation in project activities
Project report related to project planning and resources
Presentation of the Case Study associated with design, manufacturing or business model (group work)

assessment_rules: It is an indispensable condition to obtain at least 50% of the sum of the evaluation mechanisms to pass the course. Continuous evaluation is mandatory, and it is not possible to waive it. Final evaluation is not contemplated for this course. Students are considered to have renounced evaluation if they do not present the assigned project.
institution: Universidad del País Vasco/Euskal Herriko Unibertsitatea
